What is 2-way Speaker? Click to Expand A. Galaxy Buds4 Pro has two speaker drivers that handle different frequency ranges — the wide bezel-less woofer and the tweeter. The 2-way Speaker delivers sound across the full-spectrum with more detail and less distortion. *The new wider woofer on Galaxy Buds4 Pro has 19.8% larger diaphragm compared to Galaxy Buds3 Pro. Q. What is Dual Amplifier? Click to Expand A. Galaxy Buds4 Pro has two dedicated amplifiers for each speaker driver in 2-way Speaker for intricate control, minimizing interference. This separate operation makes meticulous tuning possible to produce high-quality sound. Q. What is Samsung Seamless Codec (SSC) Ultra High Quality Audio (UHQ) Option? Click to Expand A. You can turn on SSC - UHQ option when Galaxy Buds4 Series is paired with an eligible Galaxy device. The audio is delivered in extended 24-bit bit depth and 96 kHz sampling rate. Hear Hi-Fi sound in full detail, with rich audio information. *Ultra High Quality Audio (UHQ) up to 24-bit / 96 kHz is available on Galaxy S26 Series, S25 Series, S24 Series, S23 Series, Z Fold7, Z Flip7, Z Fold6, Z Flip6, Z Fold5, Z Flip5 and Tab S11 Series, Tab S10 Series, Tab S9 Series with One UI 6.1.1 or above. Additional devices may be supported in the future. *UHQ is off by default and can be configured directly in the phone settings for devices running One UI 8.0 and later. For devices running on earlier versions of One UI, configurations can be found in the Galaxy Wearable app. Q. What are the benefits of using Interpreter feature with Galaxy Buds4 Series and Samsung Galaxy smartphone together? Click to Expand A. Galaxy AI provides swift interpretation — hear it through Galaxy Buds4 Series and read it on your Galaxy smartphone. Keep your earbuds on, even when you're talking with a person that speaks in another language. *Interpreter is available on smartphone devices with Galaxy AI features included, running on One UI 6.1.1 or later. *Galaxy Buds4 Series supports Galaxy AI features such as Interpreter and Live Translate when paired with compatible Samsung Galaxy devices. Availability of Galaxy AI features may vary by device model. Samsung Account login may be required to use certain Samsung AI features. Samsung does not make any promises, assurances or guarantees as to the accuracy, completeness or reliability of the output provided by AI features. Supported languages (Regions) are Arabic, Bahasa Indonesia, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional (Hong Kong, Taiwan), Dutch, English (Australia, India, United Kingdom, United States), French (Canada, France), German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil, Portugal), Romanian, Russian (Russian Federation), Spanish (Mexico, Spain, United States), Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese, Tagalog, Gujarati. More languages will be added in future updates. Q. Does Galaxy Buds4 support ANC? Click to Expand A. Yes, along with Galaxy Buds4 Pro, Galaxy Buds4 also supports ANC. You can manage ANC in the device settings on Galaxy devices running on One UI 8.0 or later, or through the Galaxy Wearable app on Andriod smartphones that are Non-Samsung Galaxy smartphones. Or simply use Pinch Control to adjust the noise cancelling level. *Adaptive Noise Control is off by default, and can be configured directly in the phone settings for devices running One UI 8.0 and later. For devices running on earlier versions of One UI, configurations can be found in the Galaxy Wearable app. Q. Does Galaxy Buds4 Pro include ear tips? Click to Expand A. Yes, Galaxy Buds4 Pro includes 3 sets of ear tips in different sizes — small, medium and large. M-sized ear tips are attached to the earbuds by default. Change the size if you need to and find the fit that's comfortable to your ears. Q. Does the Charging Case support wireless charging? Click to Expand A. Yes, Galaxy Buds4 Series Charging Case can be charged wirelessly. Wireless charging pad is not included in the box and is sold separately. *Wireless charger and cable sold separately. Q. Does Galaxy Buds4 Pro and Galaxy Buds4 use the same Charging Case? Click to Expand A. No. The Charging Case for each Buds is shaped differently, making it incompatible between the two models. View more 6 I recommended this product. share Originally posted on Samsung UK Response from Samsung: 2026-03-27 CX The Pink Gold is an excellent choice, and it's great to hear that you're happy with the Buds4 Pro. ^KA Nithin1996 Product Ratings : 2 2026-03-20 Edinburgh Product Ratings : 2 [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] Disappointing Upgrade from Buds 3 Pro – Better Sound, but Compromised Usability I previously used the Buds 3 Pro and bought the Buds 4 Pro expecting a solid upgrade, but honestly, I’m quite disappointed 😞 Controls & Usability The biggest drawback is the shift to hard buttons on the Buds 4 Pro. Basic actions like changing music, pausing, or replaying tracks feel awkward and inconsistent compared to the soft touch controls on the Buds 3 Pro. The earlier model had smooth, responsive touch feedback, whereas here the interaction feels stiff and less intuitive. Volume control is also a downgrade. Adjusting volume isn’t as fluid or reliable as before, which affects everyday usability. Voice Features (Still Missing) Samsung still hasn’t added proper voice control features. There’s no seamless way to change tracks, answer or end calls, or pause music using voice commands directly through the buds. For a newer model, this feels like a missed opportunity and something I expected to be improved. Sound Quality & Noise Cancellation On the positive side, sound clarity is noticeably better than the Buds 3 Pro, with cleaner and more defined audio. However, active noise cancellation (ANC) feels almost the same as the previous generation—good, but not a real upgrade. It still blocks out general background noise effectively, but there’s no major improvement in handling louder or more dynamic environments. The addition of features like siren detection is useful and adds a layer of awareness, which is a nice touch. Battery Life & Charging Battery performance is solid and one of the better aspects of the Buds 4 Pro. It comfortably lasts through long listening sessions without frequent charging. Charging is more versatile now—you can use wireless charging and even charge it with a Samsung watch charger, which is a convenient upgrade over the Buds 3 Pro. Overall, battery reliability and flexibility are definite positives. Connectivity Connectivity has been very reliable in my experience. I haven’t faced any dropouts or pairing issues, and the connection remains stable during regular use, including workouts and outdoor use. This consistency is a strong point. Comfort & Fit Comfort is similar to the Buds 3 Pro. They sit well in the ear
